name: data-table
description: Config-driven table: one component plus a columns config that owns shape, sorting, pagination, and row interaction.
designIntent: Most tables are 90% configuration — columns, sortability, page size, row click. DataTable collapses that into a single columns config so application code describes WHAT the table shows, not HOW to render th/td/sort/paginate markup by hand, while keeping full control through cell renderers.

props.name: columns
props.description: Column configuration: key, header, optional cell renderer, sortable flag, align, className. Each column may define onClick(row) to make the cell content a button (column-level callbacks); onSortChange wires server-side sorting.
examples: [{ key: 'name', header: 'Name', sortable: true }, { key: 'age', header: 'Age', align: 'right' }]

props.name: data
props.description: Row data.

props.name: rowId
props.description: Stable id per row (React key + test hooks).

props.name: caption
props.description: Accessible table caption.

props.name: defaultSort
props.description: Initial sort when uncontrolled.

props.name: sortKey
props.description: Controlled sort column (pair with sortDir and onSortChange).

props.name: sortDir
props.description: Controlled sort direction.

props.name: onSortChange
props.description: Fires when a sortable header is toggled (controlled or not).

props.name: pageSize
props.description: Rows per page; enables pagination with a count line when set.

props.name: page
props.description: Controlled page number (1-based) when pageSize is set.

props.name: onPageChange
props.description: Fires when the pagination control changes page.

props.name: onRowClick
props.description: Makes rows interactive: click plus Enter/Space activation with ring focus.

props.name: renderSortIcon
props.description: Replace the default ▲/▼/↕ header glyphs with custom markup.

props.name: stickyHeader
props.description: Pin the header while the body scrolls (add a max-height via className).

props.name: density
props.description: Row density — compact shrinks text and cell padding.

props.name: zebra
props.description: Zebra-striped rows for long tables.

props.name: loading
props.description: Render skeleton placeholder rows (tbody is aria-busy while loading).

props.name: loadingRows
props.description: Skeleton row count while loading (defaults to page size, else 5) — match it to visible data so rows do not jump.

props.name: emptyMessage
props.description: Shown when data is empty.

props.name: selectAllLabel
props.description: Accessible label for the select-all checkbox.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes for the table wrapper.

props.name: selectedRowIds
props.description: Selected row ids (controlled) — enables the leading selection column.

props.name: onSelectedRowIdsChange
props.description: Fires after a row or select-all toggle.

props.name: isRowSelectable
props.description: Disable selection for individual rows.

props.name: bulkActions
props.description: Rendered above the table while rows are selected.

props.name: manualPagination
props.description: Server pagination: render data as-is, do not slice or sort.

props.name: total
props.description: Total row count across pages (summary + derived page count).

props.name: pageCount
props.description: Total page count (manual pagination).

examples.title: Sortable, paginated table from one config
examples.code:
<DataTable
  caption="Recent conversations"
  columns={[
    { key: 'title', header: 'Title', sortable: true },
    { key: 'messages', header: 'Messages', align: 'right', sortable: true },
    { key: 'updatedAt', header: 'Updated', cell: (row) => row.updatedAt.toLocaleDateString() },
  ]}
  data={conversations}
  rowId={(row) => row.id}
  pageSize={10}
  onRowClick={(row) => router.push(`/c/${row.id}`)}
/>
examples.description: Sorting, paging, empty state, and row interaction come from the config — no table markup.

examples.title: Controlled sort (server-side)
examples.code:
<DataTable
  columns={columns}
  data={rows}
  rowId={(row) => row.id}
  sortKey={sort.key}
  sortDir={sort.dir}
  onSortChange={(key, dir) => fetchSorted(key, dir)}
/>
examples.description: Pass sort props + onSortChange to let the backend own ordering; DataTable renders aria-sort either way.

antiPatterns.title: Don't sort server-owned data locally
antiPatterns.explanation: Local sorting runs on the rows you pass in. When data is paged by the API, wire onSortChange to a server query — sorting one page locally lies about global order.

antiPatterns.title: Don't put heavy interactions in onRowClick only
antiPatterns.explanation: Rows are keyboard-focusable when onRowClick is set (Enter/Space activate), but a row click is not a semantic action for assistive tech. Also provide a real link/button (e.g. in a cell) for primary navigation.

antiPatterns.title: Don't build nested tables for layout
antiPatterns.explanation: DataTable is for tabular DATA. Layout grids belong to Card/grid containers — nested tables degrade the table navigation story for screen readers.

accessibility.implementation: Sortable th elements carry aria-sort (ascending/descending/none) and use a real button for the toggle
Renders a native <caption> naming the table's purpose
accessibility.userRequirements: Provide a caption for tables longer than a few rows

accessibility.implementation: With onRowClick rows are tabIndex=0 and activate on Enter/Space with a visible ring
accessibility.userRequirements: Keep an in-cell link/button as the primary action path too

accessibility.implementation: The result count line is aria-live=polite and pagination reuses the Pagination nav (aria-current=page)

guidelines: State units in the header when relevant

compositionRules.relationship: Used internally when pageSize is set — you never need to wire it yourself
Use column cell renderers for status pills and row actions
Prefer Table when you need fully custom markup or non-interactive static data
